name: AlphaSynth Dossier Assembly and QC v1

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;const company=b.company??{};if(!company.symbol||!company.name||!company.exchange||!company.sector||!Array.isArray(company.officialDomains)||!company.officialDomains.length)throw new Error('Complete verified company identity required');const sources=Array.isArray(b.sources)?b.sources:[];const ids=new Set();for(const s of sources){if(!s.sourceId||ids.has(s.sourceId))throw new Error('Source IDs must be present and unique');ids.add(s.sourceId);}const names=['snapshot','developments','operatingEvidence','managementCommitments','risks'];const sections={};let unsupported=0,conflicts=0;for(const name of names){const input=Array.isArray(b.sections?.[name])?b.sections[name]:[];sections[name]=input.map((c,i)=>{const refs=Array.isArray(c.sourceIds)?c.sourceIds.filter(id=>ids.has(id)):[];let status=c.status;if(!refs.length){status='insufficient_evidence';unsupported++;}if(status==='conflict')conflicts++;return{claimId:String(c.claimId??`${name}-${i+1}`),text:String(c.text??'').trim(),sourceIds:refs,status};}).filter(c=>c.text);}const mc=b.marketConversation??{status:'disabled',affectsBms:false,sampleSize:0,sentiment:{positive:0,neutral:1,negative:0},themes:[]};if(mc.affectsBms!==false)throw new Error('Market conversation cannot affect BMS');const thin=sources.length<2||sections.snapshot.length===0;return[{json:{schemaVersion:'1.0.0',reportId:String(b.reportId??`${company.symbol}-${Date.now()}`),generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),company,sections,sources,marketConversation:mc,qualityControl:{unsupportedClaims:unsupported,conflicts,humanReviewRequired:true,thinEvidence:thin}}}];
